tool.title: Published site viewer
tool.description: List the published site's top-level routes and staging previews, with the pages and files under each, as read from the branch that keeps the site — saying so when the branch is empty or could not be read, never drawing zeros in its place.

inputs.name: check
inputs.description: Fail if a page is stale, instead of writing.

inputs.name: site
inputs.description: A site being built: write the pages at their declared route under it instead of under the harness's own site directory. A repository's own site build passes it (the tools layer's `visualiser-writers.ts`), since its harness docs are a pinned mount.

outputs.name: pages
outputs.description: The viewer pages, under the published site directory.

remedies.none: The routes are the remote branch's tree; offline, the page says it could not read the branch rather than listing nothing.

$comment.comment:
A viewer generator (`viewerTool` in `../lib.ts` holds the ports every viewer shares).
It reads the site's CDN branch with git, so unlike its siblings it needs the network.
